about: Structures (docs/round2-seams.md). One entry per structure, pre-listed; the page loads view/structure/<file> only for entries with ready=true. A structure lane writes its file and flips ONLY its own entry's ready to true (entries are blank-line separated so parallel lanes merge cleanly). p6 (Nested) is the default and p7 (Type) groups by kind; both build on p1 (Physical). Round 3: View options' Group by lists the entries with a `group` name, in `pick` order; picker=false keeps a structure's file loaded but out of the picker (p3: Zach wants one row per entity, the detail lives in the Table).
